fnol_text: My name is Elena Ueda and I live at 408 Juniper Street, Clinton, NC 28362. You can reach me on (555) 254-4593 or elena.ueda@example.com. After the torrential rain on the night of 16 August 2024, rainwater ran off the field behind us, across the back garden and in under the patio doors. About 5 cm of water covered the kitchen and family room floors. Policy HH-2024-00147. I'd like to claim for the damage to my home.

adjuster_notes.text: Called Mr Ueda on (555) 254-4593 to acknowledge the claim. Elena confirmed the loss date as 16 August 2024.
Site visit to 408 Juniper Street. Neighbour Lucia Nguyen-Tran was present and confirmed the timeline.
Elena sent photos and a contractor's estimate. Water line visible on walls.
